message.content: In the conversation dated 20260707, LiHua expresses concern about the basement following recent rainstorms. She specifically asks Adam if there were any issues in the basement after the storms, indicating that she wants to ensure everything is okay and is monitoring the situation herself. Adam assures her that everything seems fine, but advises her to keep an eye on the area and to notify him immediately if she notices anything unusual. LiHua appreciates this reassurance and promises to do so. Adam further suggests that she should have the contact number for the maintenance worker handy in case of any emergencies. The primary concern revolves around ensuring the structural integrity and safety of the basement after the rainfall events, which can potentially lead to water damage or other issues.
